org.xces.graf.uima
Class CASFactory

java.lang.Object
  org.xces.graf.uima.CASFactory

public class CASFactory
extends Object

This class can be used to create a CAS given a graph, a type system and an index description.

annotationMap

protected Map<String,List<org.apache.uima.cas.text.AnnotationFS>> annotationMap
Map used to associate a node with a list of UIMA annotation feature structures. This map is used when linking the annotations in the UIMA CAS into a tree. The UIMA feature structures represent the children of the node. The node's ID value is used as the key into the map.
